highlighted.title: Intrastice
highlighted.subtitle: Ultra-Compact CoreXY 3D Printer
highlighted.description:
The planned 2nd generation of my custom CoreXY 3D printer series. A RepRap-ified Makerbot Replicator Plus, designed to be one of the world's most space-efficient 220mm³ CoreXY 3D printers. A direct successor to the Chimera iXY. 

Featuring a custom edge-ML vision system for real-time anomaly detection, fully enclosed (in final design), CPAP cooling, and much more. 

Features the compact Micro4 and ADXL345 FLY by Mellow, the Orange Pi Zero 2W, and a multi voltage power bus solution for adaptable fans. 

Very modular design, easily upgrade and replace components with a simple bracket.

highlighted.title: Chimera iXY
highlighted.subtitle: High-Speed CoreXY 3D Printer
highlighted.description:
A fast 3D Printer using CoreXY kinematics, built from two different bedslingers; the Flsun i3 2017 and Mingda Magician X.

Achieves high-quality prints at 450mm/s & 800mm/s travel speeds.

Marlin/Klipper ready, 230mm^3 build volume, 10k mm/s^3 accel, 40mm^3/s flow.

Full docs, 3D models, & firmware configs are available for those looking to build their own hybrid machine. 

Current Status (7-1-26): v2.5 released; check the page for more details!

all.title: Bruce for Heltec Tracker
all.description: A reliable port of the Bruce Firmware for the Heltec IOT Tracker (v1.1, no tft). Uses a ST7789 2.0 inch TFT and 6 buttons. Functions include the UC6580 GNSS and SX1262 LoRa.

all.title: FDM Blob Detection
all.description: Lightweight ESP32-CAM Klipper Add-on for 3D printer nozzle clumping detection. Entirely local inferencing model capable of catching nozzle blobbing occurring in real time, during prints. FSM-based 'resolution' for automated fixing without human intervention.
